cases.title: Apply valid percentage discount code reduces total before payment
preconditions: Shopper has items in cart with subtotal of $100.00

steps.action: Navigate to checkout page with subtotal $100.00
steps.expected: Checkout page displays subtotal as $100.00

steps.action: Enter code 'SAVE10' in the discount code field and click Apply
steps.expected: System shows 'SAVE10' applied and new total of $90.00 is displayed before the payment section

steps.action: Observe the payment section
steps.expected: Payment section shows the amount to be charged as $90.00, not the original $100.00

cases.title: Apply valid fixed-amount discount code reduces total by exact amount

steps.action: Enter code 'FLAT5' in the discount code field and click Apply
steps.expected: System shows 'FLAT5' applied and new total of $45.00 is displayed before the payment section

cases.title: Expired discount code is rejected and total remains unchanged

steps.action: Observe the order total
steps.expected: Total remains $80.00, unchanged from before attempting the code

cases.title: Unknown discount code is rejected and total remains unchanged

cases.title: Applying a second discount code replaces the first with notification
preconditions: Shopper has items in cart with subtotal of $100.00
Discount code 'SAVE10' (10% off) and 'SAVE20' (20% off) both exist, unexpired, no minimum order value

cases.title: Discount code with minimum order value rejected when subtotal is below minimum

steps.expected: Checkout page displays subtotal as $30.00

steps.action: Enter code 'BIGORDER20' in the discount code field and click Apply
steps.expected: System displays a message stating the minimum order value required is $75.00 and the code is not applied

steps.action: Observe the order total
steps.expected: Total remains $30.00, unchanged

cases.title: Discount code with minimum order value accepted when subtotal equals the minimum

steps.action: Enter code 'BIGORDER20' in the discount code field and click Apply
steps.expected: Code is accepted, no minimum-value message is shown, and new total of $60.00 is displayed before the payment section

cases.title: Removing an applied discount code restores the original total

cases.title: Three consecutive incorrect codes abort setup and regenerate secret
preconditions: User is logged in
User does not have 2FA enabled
User has started 2FA setup and sees a QR code/secret

steps.action: Enter an incorrect 6-digit code, e.g. '000000', and submit
steps.expected: An error message states the code is incorrect and setup remains in progress

steps.action: Enter a second incorrect 6-digit code, e.g. '111111', and submit
steps.expected: An error message states the code is incorrect and setup remains in progress

steps.action: Enter a third incorrect 6-digit code, e.g. '222222', and submit
steps.expected: Setup is aborted with a message indicating too many failed attempts, and the original secret is invalidated

steps.action: Click 'Retry setup' to start the process again
steps.expected: A new QR code and new text secret are generated, different from the original secret

cases.title: Login requires valid app code after password when 2FA is enabled

cases.title: Login with recovery code succeeds once but is rejected on reuse
preconditions: User has 2FA enabled
User has a list of 8 unused recovery codes from setup

steps.action: Enter correct username and password, then on the second-factor prompt enter one of the unused recovery codes
steps.expected: Login succeeds and the user lands on their account dashboard

steps.action: Log out and attempt to log in again with correct username and password
steps.expected: User is prompted for a second-factor code

steps.action: Enter the same recovery code used in step 1
steps.expected: The code is rejected with an error stating the recovery code has already been used, and login is not completed

cases.title: Disable 2FA fails with incorrect password even if app code is correct
